## Relationships

### [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

Flora Jane is the daughter of Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md). Her mother inadvertently brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to a mix-up regarding an orphan adoption, which later leads [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit their household to investigate the mistake. Flora Jane is first introduced to the narrative through her mother's involvement in this situation.
